response.sql: WITH currency_stats AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_total_rebate, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) as avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_total_rebate) as bench FROM currency_stats), filtered_currencies AS (SELECT cs.avg_total_rebate, cs.avg_relative_gap, cs.avg_total_rebate - b.bench as excess FROM currency_stats cs CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE b.bench IS NOT NULL AND cs.avg_total_rebate > b.bench) SELECT AVG(avg_total_rebate) as avg_of_avg_rebates, AVG(avg_relative_gap) as avg_of_avg_gaps, AVG(excess) as avg_excess FROM filtered_currencies
